_comment: A cross-language attenuation. seed.biscuit is minted from the golden key and clock: ops get/list/put under corpus/, planes data and mcp, unbound, expiring 2026-01-01T01:00:00Z. attenuated.biscuit is that seed attenuated with the arguments below; an SDK attenuating the seed with the same arguments must produce a token the verifier reads as the capability below. The copy is bound to the Ed25519 key whose 32-byte seed is bind_key_seed (hex), so an SDK can sign the DPoP proof the bound copy needs; bind_jkt is that key's RFC 7638 thumbprint. LIMES_WRITE_BISCUIT=1 go test -run TestGenerateBiscuitFixtures regenerates both. Biscuit blocks use fresh random keys, so regenerating changes the bytes but not the meaning.
